## Type of change

- [ ] `feature/*` — approved functionality
- [ ] `fix/*` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor/*` — improvement without behavior change
- [ ] `chore/*` — maintenance / tooling / docs

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope respected (nothing outside V1 or an explicitly approved extension)
- [ ] No secrets, keys, tokens, or database URLs introduced
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passed
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passed
- [ ] `pnpm build` passed
- [ ] RTL/LTR considered if UI changed (Arabic-first / English second)
- [ ] Mobile/responsive considered if UI changed
- [ ] No unsafe inventory mutation if inventory changed (atomic/transactional only)
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes
